issues.description: The problem text instructs students to implement the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) as public for easier testing, but the UML in the same problem statement marks this method as private and both the template and the solution implement it as private. This conflicting visibility instruction (public vs private) can confuse students about the expected method visibility and cause uncertainty when writing or testing the method.
issues.suggestedFix: Resolve the contradiction by choosing one visibility and making all artifacts consistent. Either: (A) Update the problem statement text to remove or correct the instruction requiring the method to be public so it matches the UML and implementation (private), or (B) change the method signature in the template and solution to public (public void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)) and update any visibility mentions so the helper is public for testing. Prefer the option that matches the intended test expectations.
